body: Boeing stretched the 777X's wing to 235 feet, five inches (71.75 meters) in flight, expanding the total wing surface area by roughly 15% with a swept wing built from carbon-fiber composites. The larger, high-aspect-ratio wing delivers about a 10% improvement in fuel efficiency over previous generations and stores up to 350,410 pounds (158,943 kilograms) of jet fuel. But that span pushes the aircraft into ICAO Code F gate classifications, while most tier-one airports are built for Code E dimensions — so a fixed-wing layout would have left the jet incompatible with the gates, taxiways and hangars used worldwide.

The answer was a mechanism that folds the outer wingtip panels vertically upward after landing, shrinking the on-ground footprint to 212 feet, nine inches (64.85 meters) so the twinjet can use existing gates. Before departure, the crew commands the panels down from a dedicated toggle switch on the overhead panel, with flight management displays showing color-coded feedback until the mechanisms reach full extension. Multiple independent sensors monitor the hinge pins, and if they do not confirm both panels are fully deployed and locked, the fly-by-wire system blocks takeoff thrust. Once locked, the control system isolates the hydraulics and electrics driving the actuators, so no software glitch, electrical short or accidental crew input can unlatch the mechanism in flight.

On arrival the sequence is automatic: as the jet slows below 50 knots (92.60 kilometers per hour), the retraction sequence engages without crew input and takes about 20 seconds, with the wingtips reaching their vertical position before the aircraft clears the runway hold-short line. The FAA mandated special conditions for worst-case scenarios, and the locking bolt stays under constant mechanical tension so that even a total loss of electrical and hydraulic power cannot shift the wingtip; structural testing showed the vertical assembly can withstand sustained ground winds exceeding 65 knots (120.38 kilometers per hour). The trade-off is weight and maintenance: the hinge, actuators, locking bolts and secondary electronics add structural weight, and airlines must add checks for hydraulic fluid purity, actuator wear and sensor calibration — while a single stubborn locking bolt away from a main hub can ground the aircraft, since it cannot be dispatched with the system deactivated.
en.summary: Boeing gave the 777X a 235-foot composite wing for fuel efficiency, then had to fold its wingtips to fit existing Code E gates. The hinge, actuators, locks and software safeguards behind that single feature turned into an engineering program of its own.
en.title: Why the Boeing 777X's folding wingtips cost more to engineer than a new aircraft

body: 波音把777X的翼展拉到飛行時235英尺5英寸（71.75公尺），以碳纖維複合材料打造後掠翼，機翼總面積增加約15%，燃油效率比前代提升約10%，最多可攜帶350410磅（158943公斤）燃油。但這樣的翼展使飛機落入國際民航組織Code F登機門等級，而多數一線機場是按Code E尺寸設計；若維持固定翼布局，飛機將無法使用全球現有的登機門、滑行道與機棚。

解法是讓外側翼尖在落地後向上垂直摺疊，使地面占用的翼展縮至212英尺9英寸（64.85公尺），得以使用現有登機門。起飛前，機組以駕駛艙頭頂面板上的專用切換開關指令翼尖放下，飛航管理顯示器以顏色提示狀態，直到機構完全伸展。感測器持續監測鉸鏈插銷位置，若未確認兩側翼尖完全展開並鎖定，線傳飛控系統會阻斷起飛推力。鎖定後，控制系統隔離驅動作動器的液壓與電路，使軟體故障、電路短路或機組誤觸都無法在飛行中解鎖機構。

落地後的收摺全自動進行：飛機減速至50節（92.60公里／小時）以下時，收摺程序自動啟動，約20秒完成，翼尖在飛機通過跑道等待線前即達垂直位置。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）為最惡劣情境訂出特殊條件，鎖定插銷持續承受機械張力，即使液壓與電力全部中斷也不會移位；結構測試顯示，垂直組件可承受持續超過65節（120.38公里／小時）的地面風。代價是重量與維修：鉸鏈、作動器、鎖定插銷與備用電子系統增加結構重量，航空公司須在例行維修中加入液壓油純度、作動器磨耗與感測器校準等檢查；若在非主場站遇上插銷故障，飛機無法在系統停用狀態下放行，一根卡住的插銷就可能讓飛機停場。
zh.summary: 波音為777X換上235英尺複合材料機翼以省油，卻必須讓翼尖摺疊才能使用現有Code E登機門。圍繞這一設計的鉸鏈、作動器、鎖定裝置與軟體防護，本身就成了一項龐大的工程。
zh.title: 波音777X摺疊翼尖為何比造一架新飛機還貴
